verdict.rationale: Formant's docs and marketing explicitly describe fleet-wide dashboards with visibility into health, location, and status ('instant visibility into every robot,' 'alongside current location and status,' one unified view across vendors/fleets), plus analytics, alerts, and multi-fleet operator views. This is a core, heavily documented product capability with consistent first-party evidence across multiple pages. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification beyond vendor docs and marketing pages.
